description: Daylight saving time for a time zone: does it observe DST, the year's exact clock changes (UTC instant, local before/after), and whether a local time is valid, skipped (spring-forward gap, e.g. 02:30) or repeated (fall-back, happens twice). Use before scheduling jobs, alarms or meetings near clock changes. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

datetime.description: Local wall time to check, without offset: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]

year.description: Year to list (default: the datetime's year, else the current year)

name: dst_check
title: DST transitions and local-time check
